q1_issues.issue: The antecedent-less pronoun witness is minted from the pronoun as sk_it_1; the instruction set explicitly forbids this form and requires the class-derived symbol sk_thing_1.
The Degree level is the double-quoted string "so" — the level slot takes the surface adverb as a bare lemmatized symbol (very/really/slightly), and quoting turns it into a string literal.
"of Tampa, Fla." is rendered as LocatedIn, but LocatedIn is restricted to containment prepositions (in/at/inside/within); a surface "of" takes the entity-attached preposition-named oblique.
(Member tampa city) asserts a kind the text never states — no kind word sits inside or beside the name.
(Member florida state) likewise asserts an unstated kind.
The symbol `florida` is not derived from the surface name it carries — (Name florida "Fla.") pairs an expanded symbol with the abbreviated string, whereas the symbol is supposed to be name-derived.
"far OUT in international water" loses the particle "out" — the reified state is plain `far`.

q2_gaps: degree-result "so ADJ that <clause>" — the instruction set covers "too ADJ to V" and "ADJ enough to V" (excessive/sufficient plus a negated or positive consequence) but gives no encoding for a `so`-degree with a finite result clause, and no head for the correlative
the "City, State" appositive ("Tampa, Fla.") — comma-apposition of nested place names has no stated containment route
"any" as a negative-polarity plural determiner under a denial ("share ... with any governments") — neither the existential nor the quantifier sections address it
notes: SoThat CamelCase-joins a discontinuous correlative ("so ... that"), not a contiguous multiword connective like AsAResult/EvenThough, and the result-clause construction is not among the causal/purposive/concessive/adversative connectives the section licenses. The negated-obligation bundle (statement 17) with (Obligated ...) inside a strength-0 And, and projecting the definite "the wealth" outside it, both follow the instruction set correctly.
